_status: FROZEN v2.1 (Claude, 2026-11-16). Owner: Kimi C. Adds: 'auto: true' automatic events (no choices, resolved immediately, journaled, exempt from the 2-choice/soft-lock rules); 'sign' on money_pct; 'partner.compatibility' as a branches field_ref. v2 otherwise unchanged.
description: Data-file schema for life events (M2c). Events are data, not engine code: the annual_events/decision_offer phases load event files matching this schema, evaluate conditions against the transaction-local context, sample outcomes once per offer, and resolve from stored data. Content authors add events by adding files, never by editing the engine.

file.path_glob: src/game/events/*.json (one file per event or small thematic bundles)

DeltaValue: int | {randint: [lo, hi], sign?: 1|-1 (default 1)} — sampled once per offer creation via the per-game rng, stored in private sampled data, never rerolled at resolve
MoneyValue: int | {money_pct: [lo, hi], sign?: 1|-1 (default 1)} (fraction of the account balance, sampled once) | {sampled: '<name>', sign?: 1|-1} (references this event's sampled_at_offer block)

EventDef.id: stable unique string, never reused across versions (e.g. 'partner_divorce_offer')
EventDef.title: short user-facing title
EventDef.text: template string; placeholders: {name} = player firstname, {person:mother|father|partner|child|random_parent|random_relation} = engine-resolved referenced person's name (never regex-parsed by content)
EventDef.category: one of: childhood | teen | adult | elder | health | family | work | finance
EventDef.weight: int >= 1; relative sampling weight among eligible events WITHOUT chance_n (see occurrence)
EventDef.chance_n: OPTIONAL int: independent per-year 1-in-N offer chance (legacy parity: lightning 1/5000, kidnapping 1/250, dating offer 1/16). Events WITH chance_n bypass the weighted-pool 1-in-3 gate — the 1/N roll IS their gate; events WITHOUT chance_n join the weighted pool gated at ~1/3 of eligible years. Omit for pure weight-pool events.

conditions.requires: list of condition clauses (ALL must hold):

ONE_OF.max: optional inclusive upper bound (P8: value or max required)

ONE_OF._note: P8: age >= value sampled once per offer
P8: age < value sampled once per offer
P8: passes when NOT x_in_y(karma, value); drawn once per offer

EventDef.sampled_at_offer: optional {name: MoneyValue|{randint:[a,b]}} — extra private values sampled once at offer creation (e.g. kidnapping ransom); referenced from choices via {sampled: name}; never leaves the server
EventDef.effects: OPTIONAL event-level Effects block applied BEFORE any choice is resolved (shared 'pre-effects', e.g. breakup/divorce happiness -randint(15,18)); choice effects apply on top

choices.label: user-facing
known_effects: human-readable strings shown to the user; MUST match the real effects including ranges and negatives (e.g. '-happiness (15-18)')
choices.cost: {money: int >= 0 (default 0)} | {money_sampled: '<name>'} — GATES ONLY: affordability check producing enabled:false + reason; never posts money (P6 clarification)
choices.effects: Effects (below) applied when this choice resolves and no outcomes block is present
choices.outcomes: OPTIONAL list of {weight?: int>=1 (default 1), effects, outcome_text}: exactly ONE outcome is sampled at offer creation (weighted) and its effects/outcome_text become the option's resolved _effects/_outcome. Use for lottery-style uncertainty within a choice.
choices.outcome_text: template string (same placeholders) recorded in the journal; ignored when outcomes present (each OutcomeDef carries its own)
choices.cost_clarification: cost gates ONLY: affordability check (enabled:false + precise reason when unaffordable) and validation. cost NEVER posts. effects.money is the SINGLE ledger posting (signed). Author both for readability (cost.money == -effects.money) but only effects.money moves cash.

effects_extended.stats_values: int delta | {"randint": [lo, hi]} — ranges sampled ONCE per offer at instantiation, stored pre-sampled; journal records ACTUAL clamped deltas
effects_extended.money_form: int delta | {"money_pct": [lo, hi]} — round(current_money * U(lo, hi)), sampled once per offer
effects_extended.relationship_roles: mother|father|partner|child|all_parents|sibling|random_parent|random_relation — random_* resolved to a concrete person_id at instantiation (stored in pending person_ids)

choices.branches: OPTIONAL conditional bundle: {"sample": {"kind": "x_in_y", "x": int|field_ref, "y": int|field_ref, "draws": int}, "then": {effects, outcome_text}, "else": {effects, outcome_text}}. field_ref: "player.karma|happiness|money" or "partner.willpower|relationship|craziness|compatibility" (partner.compatibility = the engine's compatibility check for the stored generated partner, drawn once). The draw happens ONCE at offer creation; resolve never rerolls.

OutcomeDef.chance: 0..1 | {"one_in": n} | "two_draw_willpower" | "compatibility" — sampling form; two_draw_willpower = two independent willpower/100 draws, short-circuit (insist probability 1-(1-p)^2; Claude-approved M1 policy); compatibility = the engine's partner compatibility check against the stored generated partner
OutcomeDef.terminal: optional bool — fatal; resolves then jumps to year_close exactly once (engine performs death)

stats.happiness|health|smarts|looks|karma|stre: DeltaValue, applied clamped; journal records ACTUAL delta

Effects.money: MoneyValue (P2) — posts through the ledger authority with occurrence id {event_id}:{choice_id}; a single posting per choice (cost never posts)
Effects.lose_partner: bool (P7) — partner leaves the graph (engine performs graph mutation)
Effects.divorce: bool (P7) — full divorce incl. settlement via the money field (money_pct)
Effects.gain_partner: bool (P7) — the stored engine-generated partner (dating_offer) joins the graph
Effects.partner_death: "presumed dead" (P7) — routes through the mortality helper (funeral decision + inheritance), engine owns graph mutation
Effects.terminal: bool — fatal outcome; resolves then jumps to year_close exactly once

_constraints: non-auto events: at least one choice MUST have cost 0 (soft-lock rule)
non-auto events: at least 2 choices (a real decision)
auto events: no choices key (or empty list); effects sampled and applied immediately
known_effects must match effects/outcomes exactly, including ranges and negatives
if outcomes.one_of is present, per-outcome chance values must sum to 1.0 unless a special sampling form is used
terminal outcomes never leave the turn open: continuation is year_close and no further phases run except close work
EventDef.auto: OPTIONAL bool (default false): automatic event — no choices; the event-level effects apply immediately at offer time, are journaled, and the turn continues. Exempt from the >=2-choices and soft-lock rules (which apply only when auto is false or omitted).

sampling_policy.when: once per offer, at offer creation, via the per-game rng (including chance_n occurrence rolls, sampled gates, DeltaValue/money draws and outcomes.one_of picks)
sampling_policy.stored: sampled private data persists inside the pending record; reload/retry never rerolls
sampling_policy.eligibility: conditions evaluated against the transaction-local context at offer time
sampling_policy.resolve: resolve applies ONLY stored sampled data; ambient RNG at resolve is forbidden
sampling_policy.ranges_and_branches: All randomness (randint ranges, money_pct, outcome picks, branch draws) is sampled ONCE at offer creation via the per-game rng and stored pre-sampled in the pending record; resolution applies stored data only.

fit_proof._comment: the two M1 contextual templates (kept in sync with src/game/decisions.py until migration) expressed in v2 — unchanged from A's v1, they already conform (fixed deltas, cost gates, single money posting)

events.text: A kid from the neighbourhood invites {name} to play in the park.

choices.label: Go play
choices.outcome_text: {name} went to the park with a new friend.

choices.label: Stay home
choices.outcome_text: {name} stayed home and read a picture book.

events.title: An old friend in need
events.text: An old friend asks {name} to lend them $500 to get through a rough patch.

choices.label: Lend the money
choices.outcome_text: {name} lent the money and felt good about helping.

choices.outcome_text: {name} politely declined to lend the money.
